learning_outcomes.text: Learns the fundamentals of electrical machines.
Learns the operating principles of electrical machines practically.

syllabus_topics: Explanations about experiments to be conducted throughout the semester, introduction of measuring instruments to be used in experiments and explanation of connection methods to the circuit
Investigation of general structures, types and operating principles of asynchronous machines
Finding circuit parameters of asynchronous motors and Ossanna circle diagram
Investigation of general structures, types and operating principles of synchronous machines
Derivation of equivalent circuit parameters of three-phase asynchronous motor
Derivation of no-load and short-circuit operating characteristics of synchronous motor
Asynchronous machine DC experiment and no-load operation experiment
bibliography: Elektrik Makineleri, Fitzgerald, Charles Kingsley, Stephen D.Umans, Electrical Machines with MATLAB, Turan Gönen
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
